snippet.title: Auridia -- Reveal Trailer
snippet.description: Explore an interconnected world full of platforming challenges in this short metroidvania. Unlock biomes by combining abilities you've learned, including climb, grapple, throw, and parry. Examine dozens of artifacts, commune with forgotten gods, and piece together what happened to Auridia.
